question_intents: What are the AGV operation modes and how to switch between them?
data.summary: This section defines the three AGV operation modes—Automatic, Manual, and Setup—and explains how to switch between them using the main panel switch. It also details the procedure for enabling manual or setup control, including the requirement for a single operator and the specific actions available via the HMI interface.

question_intents: What are the operation modes of the AGV?

children.title: Switching between modes
children.summary: The section explains that AGV modes are changed manually by turning the switch on the main panel to the desired position (manual, setup, or automatic), which automatically updates the mode in the AGV HMI application and displays it in the top bar.

children.title: Enabling manual/setup modes
children.summary: The section explains that only one person can control the AGV at a time and describes the process of pressing the Request control button in the Manual control tab to enable operations such as raising/lowering pins and plates, controlling brakes, and steering with a joystick, noting that available operations depend on the HMI control type.
